entry_points: main_me.py main (hydra entry; builds Lenia, CVT centroids, MixingEmitter with isoline_variation, runs MAPElites.update in jax.lax.scan chunks of log_interval, saves metrics.pickle and repertoire/)
main_aurora.py main (hydra entry; builds Lenia + flax VAE, runs AURORA.update then AURORA.train each generation, saves metrics.pickle, repertoire/, params.pickle)
lenia/lenia.py Lenia.step (one Lenia timestep: FFT convolution of world with kernels, growth function, clip; computes mass/center/velocity/angle stats and is_empty/is_full/is_spread flags)
lenia/lenia.py Lenia.express_genotype / Lenia.load_pattern (genotype = kernel params m,s,h flattened + n_cells_size^2 x n_channel embryo cells; pattern from lenia/patterns.py)
common.py get_metric (parses fitness/descriptor names like pos_linear_velocity_avg into sign/metric/operator over the last n_keep steps)
qdax/core/map_elites.py MAPElites.update (emit -> score -> repertoire.add -> emitter.state_update -> metrics)
qdax/core/aurora.py AURORA.update / AURORA.train (same loop on an UnstructuredRepertoire; train re-encodes all stored observations and rewrites fitnesses/descriptors)
qdax/core/containers/unstructured_repertoire.py UnstructuredRepertoire.add (keeps the size individuals with largest mean distance to their 3 fitter nearest neighbours in descriptor space)
example_command: python main.py seed=$RANDOM qd=<algo>   (README; NOTE no main.py exists at pin -- the tree has main_me.py and main_aurora.py, each with its own hydra config_name)
example_input: Hydra configs: configs/me.yaml or configs/aurora.yaml (pattern_id 5N7KKM 'Aquarium (swarm)' from lenia/patterns.py, world_size 128, n_step 200, n_params_size 3, n_cells_size 32) + configs/qd/{me,aurora}.yaml (n_generations 20, batch_size 256, repertoire_size 1024, iso_sigma 0.005, line_sigma 0.05); CLI overrides such as qd.fitness=pos_linear_velocity_avg qd.descriptor=[color]

built_to: Repository for 'Toward Artificial Open-Ended Evolution within Lenia using Quality-Diversity' (ALIFE 2024): run MAP-Elites or AURORA quality-diversity search over Lenia genotypes (kernel parameters + embryo cells) and analyze the resulting repertoires.
pressure: NOT_FOUND_AT_PIN (README gives title only; no abstract in the tree)
success_means: NOT_FOUND_AT_PIN in README; code logs qd_score, coverage, max_fitness, n_elites (offspring added per generation) and repertoire genotype variance (common.repertoire_variance) to log.csv
main_loop_one_sentence: Each generation the MixingEmitter samples parent pairs from the repertoire and applies isoline_variation (iso_sigma Gaussian noise + line_sigma interpolation), each child genotype is expressed into a 128x128 Lenia world and stepped 200 times under jax.lax.scan while recording mass/center/velocity/angle stats and a cropped phenotype, fitness and descriptor are computed from the last n_keep steps (fitness set to -inf if the world went empty, hit the border, or spread), and children are added to a CVT MAP-Elites grid (main_me.py) or to an UnstructuredRepertoire that keeps the individuals most distant from fitter neighbours in the VAE latent space, which is retrained on stored phenotypes every generation and used to re-encode the whole archive (main_aurora.py).
behavioral_entry_point: lenia/lenia.py:Lenia.step (dynamics) and common.py:get_metric (fitness/descriptor definitions); variation in qdax/core/emitters/mutation_operators.py:isoline_variation; archive rule in qdax/core/containers/unstructured_repertoire.py:UnstructuredRepertoire.add
